title: Fenwick Order Statistics
statement:
Implement a Fenwick frequency table with direct binary lifting to find the kth present value.

Input
n q, then n initial nonnegative frequencies for values 1 through n. ADD i d changes frequency i by signed d and always leaves it nonnegative. KTH k asks for the kth value in the expanded sorted multiset, counting copies.

Output
Print the value for each KTH, or 0 if fewer than k copies exist.

Constraints
1 ≤ n,q ≤ 200000. Frequencies and |d| are initially bounded by 10⁹, and updates may raise frequencies. 1 ≤ k ≤ 10¹⁵.
